question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'a.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options: • ​**any **- refers to one or more of a thing or group of things, regardless of how many. (कुछ भी) • **a **- referring to one thing or individual. (एक) • **some **- a certain amount or number of something, not all. (कुछ) • **as **- in the same way; like. (जैसा) • Let's look at the sentence: *"As writers we live life twice, like________ cow that eats its food once and then regurgitates it..."* • The comparison being made here is to a cow that eats its food once and then regurgitates it. • Here we need to use the **indefinite article "a"** before **"cow"** to refer to the animal 'cow' in general. • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "a" to make the sentence meaningfully correct. • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2. ​ Complete passage:__ As writers we live life twice, like*** (1) __a__*** cow that eats its food once and then regurgitates it to chew and digest ***(2) __it__*** again. We have a second chance ***(3) __at__*** biting into our experience and examining it. This is our life and it's not going to last forever. There isn't time to talk about someday writing that short story or poem or novel. Slow down now, touch what is ***(4) __around__*** you, and out of care and compassion for ***(5) __each__*** moment and detail, put pen to paper and begin to write. 1cf:T93a4,
